newsitem.title: RUSSIA: President Yeltsin has operation stitches removed.
newsitem.headline: President Yeltsin has operation stitches removed.

text.p: Doctors on Wednesday removed Russian President Boris Yeltsin's stiches after his heart operation and he will move from hospital to a country residence on Thursday or on Friday, his doctor told Itar-Tass news agency.

Top Kremlin doctor Sergei Mironov told Tass that Yeltsin felt all right after his quintuple bypass surgery on November 5, and had taken a 30-minute walk in the grounds of the Central Clinical Hospital, where he is recovering from surgery.
Yeltsin would leave hospital and move to his Barvikha residence outside Moscow on Thursday afternoon or on Friday, Mironov said.
The 65-year-old Kremlin leader held his first full working meeting with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin on Tuesday, but he has yet to appear on television.
